world.title: French cities calm overnight after curfews imposed to quell violence, PM says
world.description: Sébastien Lecornu said new curfews for Tuesday night would be decided where necessary.

world.title: Ukrainians dying because US restricting intelligence sharing, Zelensky adviser tells BBC
world.description: Serhii Beskrestnov says there has not been enough time to warn people about incoming missile attacks. The White House said there had been no changes to intelligence sharing.

world.title: Seventh day of violent clashes between Albanian protesters and police
world.description: Almost 300 people have been injured, more than half of them police, as violent anti-government demonstrations show no sign of easing.

world.title: Canadian tourist found guilty of animal cruelty after stealing Las Vegas flamingo from enclosure
world.description: The man testified that he snatched Peachy from its enclosure at the Flamingo hotel and casino after drinking 30 to 40 beers, but did not mean any harm.

world.title: Mission blasts off for Mars to grab a piece of its moon
world.description: A spacecraft is set to launch on an ambitious mission to bring 10g of Martian moon dust back to Earth.

world.title: Kenya cult leader who told parents to starve children guilty of 191 murders
world.description: Self-proclaimed pastor Paul Mackenzie was found guilty of 191 murder charges - all but one of them children.

world.title: Tennis star Svitolina says emotional toll of Ukraine war led to Monfils separation
world.description: The two top tennis pros married in 2021 and have one child together.

world.title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support, says court filing
world.description: The Saudi government did not immediately respond to BBC requests for comment.

world.title: Exiled critic of Rwandan president found beheaded
world.description: Former army sergeant major Robert Kabera was a popular YouTuber and singer, who had sought asylum in Uganda.

world.title: Houthi missile strike on Yemen camp kills 50 security recruits, local authorities say
world.description: Three missiles hit a camp in government-controlled Shabwa province that officials say was being used as a training centre for new recruits.

world.title: Obama blasts federal probe of Ilhan Omar as 'so appalling'
world.description: Obama says federal agents' search of the Democrat's home was an effort to intimidate a Trump critic.

world.title: US airman dies as daredevil descent goes wrong before Texas college football game
world.description: The game continued after the incident. The American Conference said the decision was made before his death was known.

world.title: Personal attacks fire up debate before Brazil's run-off vote
world.description: The race heats up just days before the run-off between the left-wing incumbent and his right-wing challenger.

world.title: Deadly fire at Canada military base moved a kilometre 'in 30 to 60 seconds'
world.description: The blaze that killed four men and injured dozens of others spread with alarming speed, accounts suggest.

world.title: Possible wreckage of Amelia Earhart's plane likely to be trees, say researchers
world.description: Researchers travelled to a remote Pacific Island to confirm whether an object first spotted on satellite imagery in 2020 solved the mystery of the pilot's disappearance.

US.title: Rays will face Brewers in World Series to produce a first-time champion
US.description: The Rays will face the NL champion Milwaukee Brewers in the first matchup in which both teams are seeking their first World Series title since 1980.

US.title: Alberta voters reject a move toward independence in referendum backing Canadian unity
US.description: Voters in Canada's oil-rich province of Alberta have rejected a proposal to begin a process toward independence, results showed early Tuesday, delivering a victory for supporters of Canadian unit

US.title: DOJ charges 28 in California with voting crimes as election tensions escalate
US.description: The DOJ also filed an emergency request in federal court to stop California from processing ballots returned by people on the voter rolls the federal government says are "likely noncitizens.&quot

US.title: Judge chastises Trump administration plan to push ahead overhaul of DC golf course
US.description: The Trump administration wants to turn a historic public golf course into championship links. Despite a judge's order, hundreds of trees were cut down to make way for the renovation.

US.title: Schools struggle to measure how much AI experiments are helping
US.description: Schools are experimenting with AI, and a lot of them are encountering the same problem: It's hard to measure whether the technology is good or bad for students.

US.title: Australian prime minister says lawmaker critically injured by car is 'no accident'
US.description: A car hit an Australian federal independent lawmaker on Monday, critically injuring her in an apparent deliberate attack, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said. The driver was arrested.

US.title: 2026 midterms could be the most expensive on record. And, Macron condemns protests
US.description: More than $15 billion has been raised in this year's midterm elections. And, France's president is condemning the violent protests erupting across the country.

US.title: The real reason it's going to take a while to know who won in some midterm races
US.description: Hint: It's not <em>only </em>because California counts slowly.

US.title: A Kelvin wave raised sea levels on the West Coast. More are coming
US.description: A large underwater wave moved up the West Coast, raising sea levels. Scientists say it's driven by El Niño and it's going to happen again.

US.title: Morning news brief
US.description: Ukraine and Russia exchange strikes as relations between U.S. and Ukraine deteriorate, the midterms are on track to be the most expensive on record, French president denounces violent protests.
